full_prompt_en: A square anime collage illustration shows two young characters in formal, whimsical clothes against an exuberant field of patterned color and penguin motifs. The background is nearly filled with tiny dots, painted circles, strokes, confetti, and fragments of yellow, cyan, coral, and black. On the left, a dark-haired youth in a tall black top hat looks forward with large blue eyes. A black jacket, white shirt, and patterned yellow bow tie create a sharp formal silhouette amid the busy surface. Beside and slightly in front on the right, a blonde young woman faces toward the right edge. Her pale face and large blue eyes are framed by long golden hair, with a pink bow at the collar and bright patterned clothing below. A black-and-white penguin head with a yellow beak sits like an oversized hat or close companion above and between the two, its round eye looking outward. Another large penguin-like rounded form crosses the lower foreground, partly obscuring the clothing with white, black, yellow, and dotted color. Small wing and beak shapes emerge from the edges, joining the scattered paper-like pieces. The figures are drawn with clear fine contours and smooth face shading, while the background becomes looser, more splattered, and densely graphic. Bright, even light keeps the faces pale and readable despite the high saturation around them. Shadows are gentle inside clothing folds and hair rather than projected across the collage. The camera-like framing is close and frontal, with overlapping layers packed into the square. No legible words appear. The overall composition is playful and crowded, using two calm faces and bold black shapes to organize a riot of bright decorative marks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画拼贴插画呈现两名穿着正式而奇趣服装的年轻人物，置身图案繁密的彩色场域与企鹅形象之间。背景几乎被小圆点、彩绘圆圈、笔痕、纸屑般色点和黄、青、珊瑚色、黑色碎片填满。左边，一名深发青年戴高高的黑礼帽，以大蓝眼睛望向前方。黑外套、白衬衫与花纹黄色领结在繁忙表面间形成锐利的正装剪影。身旁略靠前的右侧，一名金发年轻女子朝右边缘望去。长金发围住浅色脸和大蓝眼，衣领处有粉色蝴蝶结，下方服装带明亮花纹。一颗黑白企鹅头带黄喙，像宽大的帽子或亲近伙伴，置于两人上方与中间，圆眼朝外看。另一块大型企鹅状圆形体穿过下方前景，以白、黑、黄和点状色彩部分遮住衣服。小翅膀与鸟喙形从边缘露出，加入散落的纸片般色形。人物由清楚细轮廓与平滑面部阴影画成，背景则更松散、更有泼溅感且图形密集。明亮均匀的光让脸即使被高饱和色围住也保持浅亮易读。阴影柔和地留在衣褶和发丝内部，没有投射到拼贴表面。相机式取景近而正面，重叠层次挤满方形。没有可辨文字。整体构图俏皮且拥挤，以两张平静面孔和大胆黑形组织一片明亮装饰痕迹的喧闹。
style_prompt_en: The anime collage style pairs smooth, finely outlined focal forms with a dense, splattered field of graphic marks. Pale cream and black anchor the image, while cyan, lemon yellow, coral, and pink accents circulate in tiny dots and broad curved patches. Overlap is shallow and abundant; large rounded shapes cross the lower plane, smaller fragments fill gaps, and two quieter light areas remain readable within the pattern. Fine linework and gentle gradient shading model focal surfaces, whereas the background retains rough painted edges and playful print-like texture. Illumination is broad and even, with color contrast doing more work than dramatic cast shadows. The composition is busy but controlled by repeated dark arcs and circular motifs. The overall effect is buoyant and eccentric, blending precise character drawing with spontaneous ornamental abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画拼贴风格把平滑、细线勾勒的焦点形体与密集泼溅的图形痕迹场域配对。浅奶油白与黑色固定图像，青蓝、柠檬黄、珊瑚色和粉色重音在小点与宽弧色块间流动。遮挡关系浅而丰富；大型圆形跨过下层，较小碎片填补空隙，两处更安静的亮区在图案里仍易读。细线与温和渐层阴影塑造焦点表面，背景则保留粗糙彩绘边缘和俏皮印刷般肌理。照明宽广均匀，色彩对比比戏剧性投影承担更多作用。构图繁忙，却由反复深色弧线和圆形纹样控制。整体效果轻快而古怪，把精确角色绘制与即兴装饰的丰沛结合。
theme_en: Two stylized young characters amid colorful collage and penguin motifs
theme_zh: 两名风格化年轻人置身彩色拼贴与企鹅形象之间
name: Mawaru Penguindrum
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
